newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan ex-beauty queen prepares for presidency.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan ex-beauty queen prepares for presidency.

text.p: Irene Saez, a former beauty queen and Venezuela's most popular politician, has taken the first formal step to launching a presidential bid, registering her party nationally, a spokesman said on Friday.

The move was the latest indication that the 35-year old blonde, who won the Miss Universe title in 1981 and is currently mayor of the posh Caracas district Chacao, would run in next year's presidential elections.
"We've filed the necessary paperwork with the Supreme Electoral Council," Saez's brother and political coordinator Eduardo Saez told Reuters.
Despite opinion polls that put her way head of rivals, Saez has been careful not to formally announce an election bid, even though she makes no secret of her presidential aspirations.
By registering the Integrated Representation of New Hope (IRENE) party at a national level "we've completed all the legal requirements in case she should finally decide to run," Eduardo Saez said.
Critics have dubbed her a "Barbie doll", with a fuzzy political platform and said her popularity would evaporate if she left Chacao, known locally as "Irenelandia".
